safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the documented denial of chest pain leaves an incomplete cardiopulmonary review of systems, which may prompt unnecessary follow-up questioning or documentation gaps during triage. In this abdominal/pelvic pain presentation it is unlikely to directly change immediate management or cause missed treatment by itself.
